mentions.name: Non-LLM AI Modeling Paradigm
mentions.description: This project proposes a new AI paradigm (non-LLM AI) that treats AI as a modeling problem rather than a scaling problem of text prediction. Details are published on a Substack post.
mentions.problem: Current AI approaches treat AI as a scaling problem of text prediction rather than as a modeling problem.
